source.retrieval: Sparse, blob-filtered git checkout of METADATA.pb and the family licence file (OFL.txt, LICENSE.txt or UFL.txt) per family at the pinned commit; no font binaries were downloaded
source.licence: Each family carries its own licence below; the type is recorded only when the licence file text matches the METADATA.pb licence field
source.notes: Licence sha256 is the digest of the family licence file bytes. Notice sha256 is the digest of the UTF-8 copyright notices from METADATA.pb, joined by newlines. Axis defaults are the OpenType registered-axis defaults clamped to the range, because METADATA.pb carries no default. Reserved Font Names are parsed from the licence file header; the raw clause is kept beside them.
